title: Dealer Service and Motors Mentions
summary: This topic combines dealership and service praise with one unrelated mention of a two-motor setup, so the sample is not fully coherent as a single theme.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise pleasant dealership interactions with no pressure or unrealistic expectations, alongside one favorable two-motor mention.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention dealer transfers, strong service praise, and ongoing support from named dealerships, but the excerpts do not provide enough context for a firmer sentiment assignment.

limitations: The sample is small and stratified rather than representative.
